title: Sunrise Yoga on a Panoramic Medina Rooftop
summary: Greet the sun as it rises over the Atlas Mountains with a rejuvenating yoga session on a peaceful rooftop high above the waking city.
highlights: Panoramic views of Koutoubia and Atlas Mountains
description:
Marrakech is a city of energy, but also of deep spiritual calm. This experience invites you to find your center before the hustle of the day begins. 

We meet at a hidden Riad in the heart of the Medina. Ascend to the highest terrace as the call to prayer echoes softly across the rooftops. Your instructor leads you through a gentle yet energizing flow, synchronizing your breath with the rising sun. 

The view is unmatched: storks nesting on minarets, the pink light hitting the city walls, and the snowy peaks of the Atlas in the distance. After Savasana, stay for a nutritious breakfast of fresh juice, fruit, yogurt, and Moroccan pancakes, sharing the morning peace with fellow travelers.
importantInfo: In winter, wear layers as mornings are crisp.

title: The Authentic Ritual: Traditional Hammam & Spa
summary: Surrender to the steam and scrub of the Moroccan Hammam, a centuries-old purification ritual that leaves your skin glowing and spirit renewed.
description:
You cannot visit Morocco without experiencing the Hammam. It is more than a bath; it is a social and spiritual necessity. In our selected boutique spa, you get the authenticity of the ritual with the privacy and hygiene of a luxury establishment.

The process is a journey. First, the steam opens your pores in the warm room. Your attendant applies 'Savon Beldi', a gel-like soap made from black olives. Then comes the vigorous scrub with the 'Kessa' glove—you will be amazed at how much dead skin comes off! Finally, a coating of mineral-rich Ghassoul clay softens the skin before a warm rinse. You emerge feeling lighter, cleaner, and incredibly relaxed.
importantInfo: Men and Women have separate sections or times, or private couples rooms.
You wear disposable underwear or swimsuit bottoms.
relatedExperiences: Sunrise Yoga on a Panoramic Medina Rooftop

title: Luxury Spa Day & Signature Massage
summary: Indulge in pure pampering with a full package of treatments including hammam, massage, and facial in a 5-star spa sanctuary.
highlights: Premium products (Les Sens de Marrakech etc.)
description:
Escape the chaos of the souks into a haven of silence and scent. This is the upgrade your holiday deserves. We partner with the city's most elegant spas to offer a complete restoration package.

Start with the purifying Hammam to prep your skin. Move on to a 60-minute signature massage using warm organic Argan oil, scented with verbena or orange blossom. Expert hands work out the tension of travel. Finish with a facial to hydrate your sun-kissed skin. It is half a day of bliss that leaves you floating.

title: Traditional Henna Art & Tea Ceremony
summary: Adorn your hands with intricate, natural Henna designs applied by a 'Nakacha' artist, while learning the symbols of Berber culture.
highlights: Design of your choice (Simple or Intricate)
Learn the meanings of the symbols (protection, fertility, luck)
Avoid the unsafe 'Black Henna' of the street
description:
Henna is the makeup of celebration in Morocco. Worn by brides and guests at festivals, the patterns tell stories. In this safe and relaxed workshop, you sit with a professional 'Nakacha' (Henna artist).

Browse a book of traditional Amazigh (Berber) and Fassi (Fes style) designs. As she paints the cool paste onto your skin with a syringe-like applicator, learn what the diamond, the eye, and the fibula represent. Relax with tea while it dries, leaving a temporary tattoo that will travel home with you, lasting 1-2 weeks.

title: Clay & Color: Pottery and Zellige Workshop
summary: Get your hands dirty at the potter's wheel or learn the incredible geometry of Zellige mosaic cutting with a master artisan.
highlights: Choose: Potter's Wheel OR Zellige (Mosaic) cutting
Create your own bowl, cup, or tile pattern
Learn the geometry of Islamic art
Take your fired piece home (or pick up later)
description:
Marrakech is famous for its Zellige—the colorful mosaic tilework that covers palaces and fountains. In this workshop, you realize the immense skill required to create it. 

Opt for Zellige and you will learn to chip glazed clay tiles into precise shapes using a sharp 'Menqach' hammer, then assemble them face-down into a geometric star pattern. It is a puzzle of logic and art. 

Alternatively, sit at the traditional potter’s kick-wheel. Feel the wet red clay of Safi spinning between your fingers as you coax it into a bowl or tagine. It is meditative, grounding, and harder than it looks!

title: Scent of Morocco: Perfume Creation Workshop
summary: Design your own signature fragrance using the essential oils of Morocco—Rose, Jasmine, Cedar, and Oud—guided by a perfumer.
highlights: Introduction to the Olfactory Pyramid (Top, Heart, Base notes)
Compose a 30ml bottle of Eau de Parfum to take home
description:
Smell is the strongest trigger for memory. Capture the essence of your Moroccan trip in a bottle. Morocco is a major producer of perfume ingredients, from the Roses of Kelâat M'Gouna to the Cedar of the Atlas.

In this sophisticated workshop, a 'Nose' (perfume expert) guides you through the organ of scents. You'll learn to balance fresh citrus top notes with floral hearts and deep woody bases. Will your scent be a spicy oriental or a fresh floral? You decide, mix, and bottle it, naming your creation. A truly unique souvenir.
importantInfo: Perfume needs 2 weeks to macerate (mature) before it smells its best.

title: The Sacred Script: Arabic Calligraphy Workshop
summary: Learn the bamboo quill techniques of the beautiful Maghrebi script, writing your name and ancient proverbs.
highlights: Learn to sharpen and hold the 'Qalam' (bamboo pen)
Practice the basic strokes and curves
Write your name in Arabic calligraphy
Create a final artwork on parchment paper
description:
In Islamic culture, where figurative art was traditionally discouraged, calligraphy became the ultimate visual expression of the divine. The sweeping curves of the Arabic script are everywhere in Marrakech.

Sit with a master calligrapher and learn the discipline of the ink and the reed. You will practice the 'Maghrebi' script, distinct to North Africa with its rounded, flowing forms. It demands patience and breath control. By the end of the session, you will have written a proverb or your name, creating a piece of art that bridges language and image.
